name: discover-connectors follows the skill
prompt: What connectors exist? I need the Gmail connector tools and their input schemas.

judge.check: Agent followed discover-connectors. It named connector identifier GMAIL from the live catalog or Scalekit MCP. It did not invent a slug. It did not cache a connector list in the repo.

Agent initialized the SDK from SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, and SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET, or used Scalekit MCP. It asked the human to write missing values into .env. It did not invent those values.

Agent paged list_tools or search_tools until the next-page token was empty, or printed a named tool schema. It printed tool names and input schemas. It did not execute tools or authorize a connected account.
Agent did not start integrate-agentkit or expose-agentkit-mcp.
